risks.title: Cybersecurity incidents on internal or third-party systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited at the top of risk factors, with strong language (no assurance, mitigate all risks). It concerns critical platforms (cloud, IT) and third-party vendors, which increases exposure. The cybersecurity category is highly weighted in the technology sector.

risks.title: Dependence on cloud platforms and IT vendors
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions dependence: many of our business operations depend on cloud platforms and third-party partners. Interruption of these services could cause major disruptions. The risk is linked to critical technology but is partially mitigated by vendor diversity.

risks.title: Risk of intangible asset and goodwill impairment
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed in the Critical Accounting Policies section, with potential material impact. Goodwill represents a significant portion of assets. The language (non-cash impairment charges) and sensitivity to assumptions (discount rates, growth) indicate a serious risk.

risks.title: Legal proceedings not detailed
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Legal Proceedings and refers to Note 13, without detail here. The lack of specificity suggests a moderate or managed risk. The litigation category is weighted moderately.

risks.title: Tax risk linked to estimates and reforms
risks.score_rationale: Tax risk is identified as significant, with uncertainties about geographic profit distribution and tax reforms. The effective rate is sensitive to changes (20.6% in 2025). The language (material financial impact) reinforces the severity.
